user.title: Choose a league
user.description: Pick the league you want to follow. Choose "HockeyTech (Custom)" to enter your own API key and client code for a league that is not listed.

hockeytech.title: HockeyTech credentials
hockeytech.description: Enter the API key and client code for the HockeyTech-powered league you want to follow.

hockeytech_team.title: Choose a team
hockeytech_team.description: Select the team to track. A sensor is created for that team's next or current game.

hockeytech_league_team.description: Select the team to track. A sensor is created for that team's next or current game.

init.title: Display options
init.description: Control how long a finished game stays on the card, and the colours the card uses for this team.

data.last_result_hours: Hide the previous result when the next game is within (hours)

data_description.linger_hours: Counted from the estimated end of the game, roughly three hours after puck drop. Set to 0 to switch to the next game as soon as it is final.
data_description.last_result_hours: After the finished game stops being the main scorebug, its result is shown as a small strip beneath the next game until the next game is this close. Set to 0 to never show it.
data_description.color_home_background: Card background when this team is playing at home. Shown as --home-background.
data_description.color_home_text: Text on the home background. Shown as --home-text.
data_description.color_home_accent: A third home-game tone for rules and borders, not paired with text. Shown as --home-accent.
data_description.color_away_background: Card background when this team is playing away. Shown as --away-background.
data_description.color_away_text: Text on the away background. Shown as --away-text.
data_description.color_away_accent: A third away-game tone for rules and borders, not paired with text. Shown as --away-accent.
data_description.reset_colors: Tick to discard the six colours above and go back to this team's shipped palette. NHL and PWHL teams have defaults; other leagues have none until you set them here.
